behaviours.name: Swift Justice (spell haste)
behaviours.observe_source: 300322 Effect[0] aura 216 SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS +3 ($s1), TARGET_UNIT_CASTER. A spell haste of 3% casts 3% faster: the caster's cast speed multiplier reads 1 before the learn (control) and 1 / 1.03 around a Holy Form 805301 cast.

behaviours.name: Swift Justice (melee haste)
behaviours.observe_source: 300322 Effect[1] aura 192 SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE +3 ($s1). The main-hand base attack time (Seraphim one-hand, 2300 ms) is read before and after the learn; with +3% haste the ratio is 1/1.03.

behaviours.name: Gavel critical damage
behaviours.quote: Increases the critical damage of Gavels by $s2% and they are now guaranteed to critically strike against Undead enemies.
behaviours.expected_source: $s2 = 15 (680645 Effect[1] aura 107 SPELLMOD op 15 SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS, EffectBasePoints 14). The engine applies op 15 to the bonus above the base hit only (passive-effects.md, spell-modifier op 15 'bonus' reading; ApplySpellMod SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS), so a crit of 2x base becomes 2 + 1 x 0.15 = 2.15x: whole-hit ratio 1.075. Forced melee crits of Gavel of Light 800611, critical hits only, attack power fixture 20000 so the AP part dominates the weapon die. Control: passive not learned.

behaviours.name: Grace (Dawnsear)
behaviours.quote: Increases the spell damage bonus of Dawnsear by $s1%
behaviours.expected_source: $s1 = 20 (504070 Effect[0] aura 107 on Dawnsear). Dawnsear 554406 Description: ${$m1+0+$spfi*0.765222}; $m1 = 668 + 1 .. 668 + 80 (EffectBasePoints 668, EffectDieSides 80): mean (669 + 748) / 2 = 708.5. With a spell power fixture of 10000 the coefficient part is 10000 x 0.765222 = 7652.22 and the bonus scales that part by 1.2: (708.5 + 7652.22 x 1.2) / (708.5 + 7652.22) = 1.1831. Control: Grace not learned. 823764 removes the dummy's magic resistance as in the Templar entries.

behaviours.name: Ancient Rites (maximum mana)
behaviours.quote: Increases your mana by $s2% of your Intellect,
behaviours.observe_source: 301345 Effect[1] aura 328 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_MAX_MANA_FROM_STAT, EffectBasePoints 299 + 1 = 300 ($s2), EffectMiscValueB 3 (Intellect, stat index 3). Reference Intellect 119 (class file stat 3): 300% x 119 = 357 added to the maximum mana. Maximum mana read before and after the learn; expected_gain judges the difference, control = reading before the learn.

behaviours.quote: and causes you to regenerate mana equal to 4% of your maximum mana every $t1 sec.
behaviours.name: Ancient Rites (regeneration amount)
behaviours.observe_source: 301345 Effect[0] aura 227 periodic trigger, EffectBasePoints 3 + 1 = 4 (4%), EffectAmplitude 15000, triggers 301368 whose Effect[0] is ENERGIZE_PCT. One tick after 16000 ms: 4% of the maximum mana with the aura learned = 4% x (2868 + 357) = 129. 2868 is the maximum mana read before the learn by the regen_max_mana entry's twin (max_mana, run 20261120-203339) and 357 its proven gain: a fixture of the reference character, not a clause value. Control: nothing energized before the learn.

behaviours.quote: and causes you to regenerate mana equal to 4% of your maximum mana every $t1 sec.
behaviours.name: Ancient Rites (first tick by 16.4 s)
behaviours.observe_source: 301345 Effect[0] EffectAmplitude 15000 ($t1 = 15 sec). Energize events of 301368 counted 16400 ms after the learn and cast: exactly 1, so the period is at most 16.4 s (excludes 16.5 s, +10%). Control: 0 before the learn.

behaviours.quote: and causes you to regenerate mana equal to 4% of your maximum mana every $t1 sec.
behaviours.name: Ancient Rites (no second tick by 27.5 s)
behaviours.observe_source: Same events counted 27500 ms after the learn: still exactly 1, so the period is above 13.75 s (excludes 13.5 s, -10%). With period_upper the period lies in (13.75, 16.4] s around the stated 15 s. Control: 0 before the learn.

behaviours.name: Pious (critical damage)
behaviours.quote: Increases your critical damage dealt by $s2% and your critical strikes grant allies Replenishment.
behaviours.expected_source: $s2 = 150 (300943 Effect[1] aura 163 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS, EffectBasePoints 149, EffectMiscValue 127 all schools, MiscValueB 2). Aura 163 scales the whole critical hit (Unit::SpellCriticalDamageBonus, passive-effects.md): ratio 1 + 150% = 2.5. Forced spell crits of Dawnsear 554406, critical hits only, spell power fixture 10000; control: passive not learned.

behaviours.quote: Increases your critical damage dealt by $s2% and your critical strikes grant allies Replenishment.
behaviours.name: Pious (Replenishment on a critical strike)
behaviours.observe_source: 300943 Effect[0] aura 42 SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, trigger 1257670 (Replenishment); AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:117 names 300943 for a critical damage or healing hit. A forced-crit Dawnsear 554406 is cast at the dummy before and after the learn; Replenishment 1257670 on the caster 500 ms later: 0 before, 1 after. The trigger is Dawnsear 554406, cast time 3500 ms (SpellCastTimes 22), so every wait is the stated time plus 3500 ms after the cast starts.
